title: Resolve negative sound automation positions in grace fixtures
scope: Determine the correct contract for sound events at position -0.125 in a parsed GPIF grace fixture.
acceptance: Reproduce the export failure in testdata/gp7/grace.gp.
Establish whether the event is valid preroll, a malformed source or an importer projection error.
Preserve a valid event or diagnose it at the correct boundary with public and independent evidence; do not clamp it silently.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce the export failure in testdata/gp7/grace.gp.

evidence.detail: Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
